methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Start an eval of a plugin's evals/ cases.

 The eval lives in its plugin's organization, which pays for every try.
 It returns at once, pending; get it again to follow its progress.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description:
Cancel a pending or running eval.

 Tries in flight are stopped; the eval ends partial, "cancelled", with
 the results of the tries that finished. Cancelling a finished eval
 changes nothing.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Delete an eval with its tries' conversations, runs and scores.

 A pending or running eval is refused: cancel it first.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a single eval by ID.

methods.name: ListByPlugin
methods.description:
List a plugin's evals, newest first.

 Each eval comes with its scores, aggregates, per-target results and
 notes, but with every arm's `tries` list empty, so a list stays small
 however many tries its evals ran. Get an eval by its id for its tries.

methodTypes.name: ListPluginEvalsByPluginRequest
methodTypes.description: ListPluginEvalsByPluginRequest names the plugin whose evals to list.

fields.name: PluginId
fields.description: ID of the plugin.

methodTypes.name: PluginEvalList
methodTypes.description: PluginEvalList is a list of plugin evals.

fields.name: TotalCount
fields.description: Number of evals in the list.

fields.name: Items
fields.description: The evals, newest first.

enumTypes.name: PluginEvalPhase
enumTypes.description: PluginEvalPhase is where an eval is.

values.name: plugin_eval_phase_pending
values.description: Created; the suite has not started.

values.name: plugin_eval_phase_running
values.description: Tries are running.

values.name: plugin_eval_phase_completed
values.description: Every planned try finished.

values.name: plugin_eval_phase_partial
values.description:
The eval stopped before every try ran; partial_reason says why. The
 results cover the tries that ran.

values.name: plugin_eval_phase_failed
values.description: The eval could not run at all; error says why.

values.name: plugin_eval_partial_reason_out_of_credit

values.name: plugin_eval_partial_reason_cancelled
values.description: Someone cancelled the eval.

enumTypes.name: Harness
enumTypes.description:
Harness identifies the execution engine that processes agent activities
 for a session.

 Each harness corresponds to a different Temporal activity type registered
 by the runner daemon. The harness determines:
 - Which tools the agent has access to
 - How conversation state is managed (Stigmer checkpoints vs engine-native)
 - Which LLM models are available
 - Billing tier and cost structure

 HARNESS_UNSPECIFIED defaults to HARNESS_NATIVE for backward compatibility.

values.name: HARNESS_NATIVE
values.description:
Stigmer's native execution engine.

 Stigmer-managed checkpoints, custom tools, sandbox isolation,
 pause/resume, and full HITL approval flow.

values.name: HARNESS_CURSOR
values.description:
Cursor SDK execution engine.

 Cursor-managed conversation state, Cursor built-in tools + MCP,
 both local and cloud runtimes. Premium billing tier.

enumTypes.name: PluginEvalTryState
enumTypes.description: PluginEvalTryState is where a try is.

values.name: plugin_eval_try_state_pending
values.description: Planned; not started.

values.name: plugin_eval_try_state_running
values.description: Its run is running or being graded.

values.name: plugin_eval_try_state_graded
values.description: Graded; score holds the result.

values.name: plugin_eval_try_state_not_graded
values.description: Finished without a score; not_graded_reason says why.

enumTypes.name: ApiResourceVisibility
enumTypes.description:
Visibility controls who can access an API resource.
 This is orthogonal to ownership - visibility is about access control,
 while ownership (org) determines who manages the resource.

 Key distinction:
 - Ownership: Which organization controls/manages the resource
 - Visibility: Who can access/use the resource

 All resources belong to an organization. Visibility determines which
 users, inside that organization or in its child organizations, can read
 the resource. No level reaches every
 account on the server.

 The visibility levels map to FGA tuples:
 - PRIVATE: no additional viewer tuples (owner-only access)
 - ORG: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer tuple (everyone in the
   org — the org role hierarchy flows downward, so owners, admins, members
   AND read-only viewers all satisfy the organization#viewer userset)
 - CHILD_ORGS: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer
   (everyone in every child organization of the owning organization)
 - PUBLIC: retired; see the value's own comment.

values.name: visibility_private
values.description:
Only the owner, explicitly granted principals, and — for blueprint kinds
 in the cloud edition — org admins can access.
 This is the default for personal and run-scoped resources.

 Org admins count as owners of blueprint kinds (agent, agent_share,
 skill, mcp_server), so a private blueprint stays
 manageable — and visible — to its org's admins. Personal kinds
 (sessions) stay creator-only.

values.name: visibility_public
values.description:
Retired. This level made a resource readable to every account on the
 server; it is refused at create and at updateVisibility for every kind,
 and every stored row that held it has been moved to visibility_org.
 Sharing across organizations happens through plugins (a copy is
 installed and owned) or, from a parent organization to its children,
 through visibility_child_orgs.

values.name: visibility_org
values.description:
Everyone in the owning organization can access (read) this resource —
 all org roles including read-only viewers (the role SSO auto-provisioning
 grants by default). Running or otherwise spending against the resource
 still requires the org-level member-or-guest permissions
 (can_create_session / can_create_run_in); org visibility widens
 read, never spend.

 FGA tuple: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer
 (The tuple once targeted organization#member, which
 excluded viewer-role users; the authorization model no longer admits
 that shape.)

values.name: visibility_child_orgs
values.description:
Everyone in every child organization of the owning organization can
 read and run this resource: the shared catalog an organization offers
 the organizations under it (spec.parent_org). Child organizations
 created later gain access automatically, and no other organization
 does. Instances, sessions, runs and vaults are never shared
 this way: each child runs the shared blueprint inside its own boundary.

 Only valid for blueprint kinds with supports_child_orgs: true, and only
 in an organization that is not itself a child.

 FGA tuple: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer

enumTypes.name: PluginEvalAblation
enumTypes.description: PluginEvalAblation says whether a case also runs without the plugin.

values.name: plugin_eval_ablation_with_without
values.description: Runs with and without the plugin.

values.name: plugin_eval_ablation_none
values.description: Runs with the plugin only; no comparison is made.

values.name: api_resource_version
values.description: Immutable version record tracking changes to an API resource.

values.name: iam_policy
values.description: Role-based access control policy for granting permissions on resources.

values.name: identity_account
values.description: User account in the identity system.

values.name: api_key
values.description: Credential for programmatic API access.

values.name: invitation
values.description: Shareable link for joining an organization with a configurable role.

values.name: identity_provider
values.description: External identity provider for federated authentication.

values.name: oauth_app
values.description: Registered OAuth application with an external vendor for outbound authentication.

values.name: platform_client
values.description: OAuth2 client credential for platform builders embedding Stigmer into their products.

values.name: team
values.description: Named group of an organization's people that access is shared with as one.

values.name: organization
values.description:
The boundary that holds people, Agents, Sessions and secrets
 together; nothing outside it sees them.

 Its id is a minted org_<ulid> that never changes; every organization-scoped
 resource names it by that id (metadata.org). Its slug is unique across the
 server and may change through rename; requests may name the organization
 by either.

values.name: platform
values.description: Singleton platform instance representing the Stigmer deployment.

values.name: agent
values.description: AI assistant with instructions, tools, skills, and a delegation model.

values.name: run
values.description: Single run of an agent within a session, tracking tool calls and responses.

values.name: session
values.description: Conversation thread between a user and an agent.

values.name: skill
values.description: Knowledge resource that provides domain-specific context to an agent.

values.name: mcp_server
values.description: External tool server connected via the Model Context Protocol.

values.name: agent_share
values.description: Hosted chat link for an agent with its own audience, origins, and credentials.

values.name: agent_channel
values.description: Connection binding an agent to an external messaging platform workspace.

values.name: channel_app
values.description:
Customer-owned messaging-platform app (e.g. a Slack app) that agent
 channels can install through instead of the shared platform app.

values.name: schedule
values.description: Recurring trigger that runs an agent on a cron schedule.

values.name: memory
values.description: Agent-proposed, user-confirmed fact the platform remembers about a person.

values.name: plugin
values.description:
An installed Agent Plugins package: the archive Stigmer materialised into
 skills, MCP servers and an agent, and the handle that upgrades
 and removes them together. A plugin is what you install; an agent is what
 runs. Members are the resources labelled with the plugin's id.

values.name: vault
values.description:
A person's or an organization's box of logins (matched by a tool's
 address) and secrets (matched by name) that runs use.

values.name: score
values.description:
One grade of a finished run: a person's thumbs or a free run-health
 check.

values.name: evaluator
values.description:
AI grading switched on for one agent: its sample rate, monthly spending
 limit and judge model.

values.name: plugin_eval
values.description:
One run of a plugin's own evals/ cases: every case tried with and
 without the plugin, on the models the eval names.

values.name: plan
values.description:
Catalog entry naming a bundle of entitlements and the terms that buy it.

 Platform-level: a plan belongs to no organization, so it carries no
 authorization scope and no owner. Immutable once created; a change of
 terms is a new Plan and the old one retires.

values.name: subscription
values.description:
An organization's binding to a Plan; at most one active per organization.

 System-created: the payment system drives its lifecycle, so it has no
 owner and grants no roles. Its reads and writes authorize on the
 organization through the billing permissions.

values.name: license
values.description:
A signed grant of entitlements to a self-hosting customer for a term.

 Platform-level: issued by the cloud's operators and verified offline by
 the Enterprise server, so the customer is a value inside the license
 (which may or may not name a cloud organization) and the kind has no
 authorization scope and no owner. Claims are immutable once signed; a
 renewal is a new License.

resourceDescription:
PluginEval is one run of a plugin's own evals.

 A plugin author writes test cases in the plugin's evals/ folder, in
 Claude Code's plugin-eval format: a request a user might type, plus
 checks such as "the reply mentions the renamed function", "the skill was
 used" or a rubric for an AI judge. A PluginEval runs every case several
 times with the plugin and several times without it, on each model it
 names, and records per case the score with and without the plugin, the
 difference, and whether every try passed. Every try is a conversation:
 in Stigmer Cloud the eval's viewers open it, read-only; in open source the
 eval's creator owns it, and the other viewers read its scores.

statusType.name: PluginEvalStatus
statusType.description:
PluginEvalStatus holds an eval's progress and results: per case, per
 target and per arm, the score, the difference the plugin makes, and
 every try with its run.

fields.name: Phase
fields.description: Where the eval is.

fields.name: PartialReason
fields.description: Why a partial eval stopped early; unspecified otherwise.

fields.name: Error
fields.description:
One sentence naming what failed when the phase is failed, as in
 "the plugin archive could not be read"; empty otherwise.

fields.name: Cases
fields.description:
The cases the suite holds, in directory order, each with its
 results.

fields.name: Aggregates
fields.description: The suite's totals.

fields.name: CostUsd
fields.description:
Estimated model cost so far of every try and every AI-graded check,
 in US dollars.

fields.name: TriesTotal
fields.description: Tries the eval plans in all, and tries finished.

fields.name: StartedAt
fields.description: When the eval started running and when it finished.

fields.name: ProvisionalDelta
fields.description:
True while the comparison with and without the plugin also measures
 the agent Stigmer composes for the plugin at install, not only the
 plugin's parts.

fields.name: VaultAttachers
fields.description:
Who attached each of this eval's vaults, by vault id: the account
 whose permission to use the vault each try checks, since a try has no
 person.

fields.name: Audit
fields.description: Standard audit information (created_at, updated_at, created_by, etc.)

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAudit
statusNestedTypes.description: ApiResourceAudit contains both spec-level and status-level audit details.

fields.name: SpecAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's specification (desired state).

fields.name: StatusAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's status (actual state).

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAuditActor
statusNestedTypes.description:
ApiResourceAuditActor represents the entity that performed an action.

 This is the platform's single actor vocabulary: every "who did this"
 reference (created_by / updated_by, version-history applied_by / pushed_by,
 approval resolved_by_actor) uses this message, so actor rendering is
 uniform across all surfaces.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the actor.

fields.name: Avatar
fields.description: URL to the actor's avatar image.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description:
Human-readable display name (e.g. "Ada Lovelace"). Empty when unknown;
 renderers fall back to email, then id.

fields.name: Email
fields.description:
Email address of the actor. Empty when unknown or not applicable
 (e.g. machine accounts).

fields.name: PlatformClientId
fields.description:
The PlatformClient whose minted user token the actor acted through.
 Empty for every other credential, and on an actor that records no act
 (an account's profile lookup).

fields.name: CreatedBy
fields.description: Actor who created this resource.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Actor who last updated this resource.

fields.name: UpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Type of the last event (e.g., "created", "updated").

statusNestedTypes.name: PluginEvalAggregates
statusNestedTypes.description: PluginEvalAggregates are the suite's totals, in Claude Code's names.

fields.name: OverallScore
fields.description: The mean with-plugin score over the cases that ran.

fields.name: CasesPassed
fields.description: Cases whose with-plugin score reached the threshold on every target.

fields.name: CasesTotal
fields.description: Cases that ran.

fields.name: MeanDelta
fields.description:
The mean difference the plugin made, over the cases with a
 comparison; unset when none had one.

fields.name: CasesNotRun
fields.description: Cases listed but not run.

statusNestedTypes.name: PluginEvalArm
statusNestedTypes.description: PluginEvalArm is one arm's tries and their summary.

fields.name: Score
fields.description: The mean score of the graded tries; unset when none was graded.

fields.name: PerfectRuns
fields.description: Graded tries in which every scored check passed.

fields.name: GradedTries
fields.description: Tries that produced a score.

fields.name: Tries
fields.description: Every try, in order.

statusNestedTypes.name: PluginEvalCase
statusNestedTypes.description: PluginEvalCase is one case of the suite and its results.

fields.name: CaseName
fields.description: The case's name, from its case.yaml or its directory.

fields.name: Path
fields.description:
The case's directory, relative to the plugin's root, as in
 "evals/review-fires".

fields.name: CaseTags
fields.description: The case's tags.

fields.name: NotRunReason
fields.description:
Why the case is not run, naming the feature Stigmer does not run yet,
 as in "not run: context.scaffold_script"; empty when the case runs.

fields.name: Targets
fields.description: Results per target, in the eval's target order.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description:
Notes about how the case was run, as in "max_turns 4 raised to the
 run's minimum of 10 tool rounds".

statusNestedTypes.name: PluginEvalCaseTarget
statusNestedTypes.description: PluginEvalCaseTarget is one case's results on one target.

fields.name: Target
fields.description: The engine and model.

fields.name: NotRunReason
fields.description:
Why this case did not run on this target, as in "not run: model
 'sonnet' is not in Stigmer's catalog"; empty when it ran.

fields.name: WithPlugin
fields.description: The tries with the plugin.

fields.name: WithoutPlugin
fields.description:
The tries without the plugin; unset when the eval makes no
 comparison.

fields.name: Delta
fields.description:
The with-plugin score minus the without-plugin score; unset when
 either is missing.

fields.name: Passed
fields.description: Whether the with-plugin score reached the threshold.

fields.name: PassK
fields.description: Whether every with-plugin try scored 1 (pass^k, k being the tries).

statusNestedTypes.name: PluginEvalTarget
statusNestedTypes.description: PluginEvalTarget is one engine and model a case runs on.

fields.name: Harness
fields.description: The engine. Unspecified is the native engine.

fields.name: ModelName
fields.description:
A model id from the model catalog for that engine, as in
 "claude-sonnet-4-6". Empty uses the engine's default model.

statusNestedTypes.name: PluginEvalTry
statusNestedTypes.description: PluginEvalTry is one try: one run in a fresh conversation.

fields.name: Index
fields.description: The try's number in its arm, from 1.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description: The conversation and run of the try; empty until they exist.

fields.name: State
fields.description: Where the try is.

fields.name: Score
fields.description:
The try's score from 0 to 1 when graded: the weighted share of its
 scored checks that passed.

fields.name: NotGradedReason
fields.description:
Why the try produced no score, as in "platform busy" or "out of
 credit"; empty when graded.

fields.name: Error
fields.description: The run's own failure, when it had one, as in "timed out after 300s".

fields.name: CostUsd
fields.description:
The try's estimated model cost, AI-graded checks included, in US
 dollars.

fields.name: DurationSeconds
fields.description: How long the try ran, in seconds.
